notes.title: Parts Unknown International!
notes.content: We have rebranded this version of Parts Unkown we wanted to focus on international locations for this iteration.

notes.title: Parts Unknown 2025 will be released 2/6/2025 for Fashion Week!
notes.content:
We want to thank all of our fans for continuing to support us. We have been working very hard on the game to provide the best experience as possible. Updates to Parts Unknown 2024 have been implemented. Our main focus is Parts Unknown 2025 we will have events for major cash prizes. The game will be free to download.


-Parts Unknown Productions

notes.title: Grapple Update
notes.content:
We have made updates to the grappling system this will be one of our last updates for 2024. We are working with PlayStation and Xbox for 2025. Release date will be 1/1/2025 for Parts Unknown 2025. We want to thank everyone for their support. 


-Parts Unknown Productions

notes.title: Updated AI
notes.content: We noticed some issues with NPC's we are working hard to fix and update the game every day we want to thank everyone for supporting us we are trying to build a community we are more than happy to reward our players please keep the game updated for a chance to win more prizes.

notes.title: Quick match tournament is over
notes.content: We will have another tournament for Halloween the current tournament is over. We have adjusted our focus on developing Parts Unknown 2025 we want to thank all of our supporters for playing the game. Parts Unknown 2025 will be available for PlayStation and Xbox we will have more takedowns, fighting styles, sports, and multiplayer options for 2025!

notes.title: We are working on Parts Unknown 2025
notes.content: Pre order will be available in the next few months. Parts Unknown 2025 will be available on 1/1/2025 for Xbox, PlayStation, and Steam. $150 quick match grand prize for Parts Unknown 2024 ends 9/1/2024

notes.title: $150 Grand Prize Quick Match still available!
notes.content: First fighter to 100 wins will win $150 via PayPal. Quick Match Grand Prize will be ending 8/31/2024.

notes.title: Grand Prize is now $150
notes.content: Please take a picture of the Quick Match menu and the date and time once at 100 wins and send the picture to partsunknown2024@outlook.com. First person to 100 wins will receive the grand prize via PayPal. Keep up with your win and rep progress via the leaderboard.

notes.title: Quick Match grand prize is now $125
notes.content: Please keep your game version up to date we will be updating the game throughout the Quick Match competition. The grand prize may continue to rise so make sure you are practicing and at the top of the win leaderboard.

notes.title: Keep the game updated for crash prize $100
notes.content: Please make sure your game is up to date at all times we are updating the game constantly. The $100 cash prize will be available until someone reaches 100 wins in Quick Match mode.

notes.title: $100 cash prize!
notes.content: We have been working hard on Quick Match mode we will have grand prizes weekly! Current prize will be rewarded to the first player with 100 wins in Quick Match Mode! You will also receive all of the current upgrades for free! We will reach out to the winner via Steam to send the reward. Goodluck!

notes.title: Quick Match Competition!
notes.content: Quick match multiplayer now available. First fighter to 100 will receive a special prize.

notes.title: Soccer!
notes.content: Soccer is now available we patched the fighting also the game will continue to improve. Parts Unknown 2025 will be available for Xbox and PlayStation.

notes.title: Earn Rep to increase damage!
notes.content: Earn rep to increase the damage inflicted on your opponent's when fighting.

notes.title: Basketball brawl!
notes.content: We will continue to work on basketball animations.

notes.title: Dunking in Unknown Park
notes.content: Basketball animations and physics will continue to improve. Please make sure you are playing the latest version of the game at all times.

notes.title: Unknown Park UI update
notes.content: We fixed our UI instructions when loading into the park. More dribble animations and shots coming soon. We are also working on 1v1 and 2v2

notes.title: Updated Dribbling
notes.content: We will be patching Unknown Park continuously to improve dribbling and shooting.

notes.title: Unknown Park update!!!
notes.content: You can now dribble and shoot full court! We have been working to incorporate fighting into other sports! We will continue to build new locations. New animations for basketball will be available soon.

notes.title: Grappling update
notes.content: We patched the grappling once again please make sure you are playing the latest version of the game at all times. Our goal is to make a fluid online brawl atmosphere.

notes.title: Grapple update
notes.content: We patched the grappling. Special prizes will be rewarded to the top 3 fighters on the leaderboard.

notes.title: Updated AI
notes.content: We have made improvements on the AI congratulations to the top fighter on the leaderboard "Bruhrittoo" currently with 2326 Rep points.

notes.title: Network update
notes.content: Please have your update settings for the game set to automatic we are constantly making updates to the network.

notes.title: Unknown Park!
notes.content: Unknown Park is now available.

notes.title: Sever outage from 3/3/2024 - 3/4/2024 (Resolved)
notes.content: We had an issue with our server that has now been resolved. Please make sure you are playing the latest version of the game.

notes.title: ReadyPlayerMe no longer required!
notes.content: You no longer have to create an account with ReadyPlayerMe to play the game.

notes.title: Welcome To Parts Unknown 2024!
notes.content:
We want to thank everyone for their support we were able to make a lot of improvements to Parts Unknown 2024! Special prizes will be rewarded to the top 3 fighters on the leaderboard. Online events will be announced soon!

- Parts Unknown Productions
